thread:
maria: kicking off geo rollout US -> EU -> APAC, canaries started in US, will wait 10m for steady-state before EU cutover :eyes:
deploy-bot: starting deploy v2.3.1 -> rolling canary slice ids: canary-us-7a, canary-eu-3b, canary-apac-2c
ben: smoke tests on canary-us-7a are green (latency p50 42ms, p95 110ms) :thumbsup:
kevin: heads up — eu-cluster-2 reporting repeated thermal excursions, GPU headroom dipping. scheduling thermostat mitigation now.
ops-sre: adding 4 warm nodes to eu-cluster-2, actioned pool-scale +4 (eta ~12m).
nisha: recommendation: hold EU cutover until nodes warm + 5m. pin EU traffic to v2.3.0 for stability if latency spikes during warmup. APAC canary should be kept low QPS until we confirm EU recovery.
maria: agreed. holding EU. leaving APAC decision to ops on capacity and model variant.
kevin: quick log snippet from eu node:
```
[2026-03-20T14:01:02Z] thermal: GPU0 temp 92C, throttling frequency -> decreased perf
[2026-03-20T14:02:10Z] kv-cache: evictions increased, batch sizes reduced
```
kevin: looks like sustained long-seq workload triggered it.
deploy-bot: autoscaler paused for eu-cluster-2 due to node pressure, canary-eu-3b put into HOLD state.
ops-sre: confirmed scale-up started, but recommend pin EU routes to previous model. Executing pin: `route-pin eu v2.3.0` now.
deploy-bot: route-pin acknowledged for eu: `eu -> v2.3.0` (manual pin by ops-sre).
ben: APAC canary traffic results: short prompts fine, but long prompt tests hit OOM on quantized path occasionally. Probabilistic failure, lowering APAC canary QPS to 2rps and switching to fallback variant `v2.3.1-quant-lite` for long sequences.
nisha: rollout policy reminder: if EU p95 latency > 200ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows => auto-rollback to v2.3.0 and notify SRE. We'll keep that in place.
maria: leaving runbook note and change window: EU hold, APAC reduced QPS and variant fallback, US can continue ramping to 50% per plan. I'll update release notes and notify sales/CS. :spiral_note_pad:
kevin: after scale completes we'll re-run long-seq soak on eu-staging-2, ETA 20m.
ops-sre: scale finished +4, nodes warmed. removing HOLD once smoke confirmed.
deploy-bot: canary-eu-3b remains pinned, unpin requires explicit `route-unpin eu` from ops-sre or maria.
maria: ok – leaving EU pinned until we verify two 5m windows with p95 < 150ms and no thermal alerts. APAC: keep pinned variants and low QPS, retest in 30m. Anyone raising objections?
kevin: no objections. I'll monitor and post metrics when ready.
nisha: adding the rollback triggers to the ticket and runbook (#PR-5234).
maria: thanks all — holding here. will reopen thread when we unpin or if rollback triggered. :white_check_mark:
